title: Text: DET Michele Wysocki ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Sorry never got back. I would call first, if no answer then send a quick to the point text. Jessica Langolf is still pretty tight with the Tigers tho and is a busy body, so it could go with ways, she could be helpful or she could tell everyone she knows you contacted her.
Yep, that’s what I’m going to do. I don’t know if I’m super concerned at this point about people knowing. Thanks for talking yesterday
No problem, just giving you a heads up.
